title: Vendor Corporate-Action Treatment Rules
description: Machine-readable vendor treatment rules for the corporate-action hub (§5b, §7a-i, §9). Keyed by {vendor, event_type, index_type} — a 3-D matrix. `event_type` is the app's canonical 13-event id (per src/lib/event-taxonomy.ts `CANONICAL_EVENTS`); the ISO 20022 CAEV code for the same event lives in `caev`. `index_type` is '*' when the vendor's treatment does not vary by the represented return or weighting branch. `lead_days` is the vendor's published per-event publication lead time before ex-date — the input to slice 1's coverage-window engine (7a-i). Where the source doc does not state a lead time, `lead_days` MUST be null (never a fabricated number), and `lead_days_confidence` reflects why.

index_type.description: Index return-variant or weighting-branch discriminator. '*' means the treatment does not vary by the represented branch.

effective_day.description: Day in a review month: an ordinal weekday or business day, e.g. third-friday or last-business-day.

event_types.description: The app's canonical event-type ids that rules cover.

index_types.description: The index/fund-type dimension values in use ('*' for rules that do not vary by return or weighting branch; see §5b taxonomy).

vendors.description: Vendor ids that rules cover (see src/lib/vendors.ts `VENDOR_IDS`).

vendor.description: Index vendor id (msci, sp, ftse, stoxx, solactive, morningstar, vettafi).

event_type.description: App canonical event-type id (one of CANONICAL_EVENTS, e.g. "special-dividend").

caev.description: ISO 20022 CAEV code where one applies (DVOP, BONU, SPLT, SPIN, RHDI, OFFO, REDU, TEND, MRGR, DELI, BANK, CONS).

index_type.description: Index return-variant discriminator; '*' when the treatment does not vary by return variant.

treatment.description: Prose statement of what the vendor does for this event. null only when the corpus has nothing (confidence 'absent').

lead_days.description: Vendor's published publication lead time before ex-date in days, or null when the source does not state one (never invent a number).

lead_days_confidence.description: lead_days provenance: 'stated' when the doc gives it outright, 'inferred' when reasoned from surrounding text, 'absent' when the doc does not state a lead time, 'practitioner' when the lead time is domain knowledge supplied by a practitioner and is NOT stated in the vendor's document.

source_ref.description: Doc + section/heading the rule came from (e.g. "SOURCES/index-vendor-methodology.md §5 (Stock Split / Consolidation)").

confidence.description: treatment provenance: 'stated' when the doc says it outright, 'inferred' when reasoned from surrounding text, 'absent' when the doc does not address the event, 'user-set' when an operator tuned the value in the coverage settings surface (§11c constraint 2: a user-typed lead time must never render identically to one the methodology states).

timing.description: When the vendor applies the change: 'on-event' intra-quarter on the event date; 'threshold-gated' intra-quarter unless deferral_condition holds, then at the next review; 'at-review' always at the next scheduled review (QIR / rebalance). Absent = not yet tagged.

deferral_condition.description: For timing 'threshold-gated': when the vendor defers the change to its next review, in the vendor's own terms.

mapping_note.description: Required for inferred event-id mappings: state why the source terminology maps to the app event without claiming the source used that exact label.

conditions.description: Rule-selection conditions the {vendor, event_type, index_type} tuple cannot carry. First real instance (2026-09-02): MSCI's ordinary-vs-special cash dividend split keys off dividend size as a percentage of market price. Null/absent when the tuple fully determines the rule.

dividend_size_threshold_pct.description: Quantitative ordinary/special cash-dividend boundary as a percentage of market price (MSCI: 5). Absent when the vendor states no numeric boundary (S&P DJI, FTSE Russell, STOXX qualitative; VettaFi, Solactive absent).

threshold_side.description: Which side of dividend_size_threshold_pct this row applies to ('at_or_above' = special treatment, 'below' = ordinary).

rights_moneyness.description: Whether the rights subscription price is below market price (in-the-money) or at/above it (out-of-the-money).

index_membership.description: M&A: which deal party is a constituent of the index (target-only = a non-constituent acquires a constituent).

consideration.description: M&A: how the deal is paid.

vendor_profiles.description: Per-vendor facts not tied to one event: the scheduled review calendar (where a deferred change lands) and the policy for events the methodology does not cover. null = not yet sourced.

effective_by_month.description: Mixed-month scheduling form. Keys are month numbers and must cover precisely the values in months; check-deferral enforces that cross-property constraint.

index_calendars.description: Per-index calendars: the QIR/rebalance at which a deferred share or float change lands for that index, where its own rulebook sets one. indexes are exact fund-master underlying_index names; an index with no entry falls back to review_calendar.

effective_by_month.description: Mixed-month scheduling form. Keys are month numbers and must cover precisely the values in months; check-deferral enforces that cross-property constraint.
